title: teucrium polium var. pseudohyssopus
intro: Teucrium polium var. pseudohyssopus, commonly known as Turkish hyssop, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Turkish hyssop include expectorant, antispasmodic, and antifungal activities, which contribute to its use in treating coughs, colds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Turkish hyssop include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic applications.
